card.name: Archfiend of Gilfer
card.officialText: When this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip this card to that target. That monster loses 500 ATK while equipped with this card.

twoVTwoReview: The optional When trigger is gated by the send-to-GY event being the last event in the chain/event window.
A face-up monster on either team's shared Monster Zones can be selected; face-down monsters are not exposed or targetable.
The physical owner of Gilfer is retained even when its teammate is the active effect controller.
The Equip Card occupies one of the trigger controller team's three shared Spell/Trap Zones, including when the target is controlled by the opposing team.
The -500 ATK contribution exists only while this physical Equip UID remains attached; detachment removes exactly that contribution.
The source must still be in the shared Graveyard and the target must still be face-up and equip-legal at resolution.
